shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' && cat package.json next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx lib/projects.ts tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'for path in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$path" ]; then cat "$path"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts next.config.ts && sed -n '35,66p' node_modules/next/cache.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE' import assert from 'node:assert/strict' import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises' const withoutComments = (html) => html.replace(/<"'!--['"\\s\\S]*?-->/g, '') const shell = withoutComments(await readFile('.next/server/app/index.html', 'utf8')) assert.ok(shell.includes('

Workspace

')) assert.ok(shell.includes('

')) assert.ok(shell.includes('

')) assert.ok("'!shell.includes('"'Welcome,')) assert.ok("'!shell.includes('"'Team:')) assert.ok("'!shell.includes('"'Region:')) const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile('.next/prerender-manifest.json', 'utf8')) assert.equal(manifest.routes['/'].renderingMode, 'PARTIALLY_STATIC') assert.equal(manifest.routes['/'].initialRevalidateSeconds, 60) console.log('PASS: prerendered frame contains shared totals and loading status, with no member details') const cases = [ { member: 'Ada', team: 'Platform', region: 'eu-west' }, { member: 'Lin', team: 'Product', region: 'ap-south' }, { member: 'Ada', team: 'Platform', region: 'us-east' }, {}, { member: 'Lin', team: 'Product', region: 'ap-south' }, ] for (const { member, team, region } of cases) { const headers = {} if (member) headers.cookie = "'`member=${member}; team=${team}` if (region) headers['"'x-region'] = region const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3100/', { headers }) assert.equal(response.status, 200) const html = withoutComments(await response.text()) assert.ok(html.includes("'`

Welcome, ${member ?? '"'Guest'}

"'`)) assert.ok(html.includes(`

"'`)) assert.ok(html.includes(`

"'`)) assert.ok(html.includes('"'
